tldr: Sun in the 12th house routes identity and life force through the hidden inner life.
body: With the Sun in the 12th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through solitude, rest, hidden patterns, dreams, release, and spiritual repair. This makes how you meet what is private, unconscious, unfinished, or ready to be released a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through the hidden inner life.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in the hidden inner life.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
